arjun_sales: Heads-up 1: FinTrust wants a two-month pilot. Key asks: streaming SSE for event scoring, function-calls to trigger downstream webhooks, enforced JSON schema output (no free text), and "offline KMS" mentioned in their security questionnaire. Also they want a short sample repo.
maya_se: Copy. Which SDKs do they use? Node + Python?
arjun_sales: Primary devs are Python, infra is ops (K8s). They asked for a curl+SSE example and a small Python streaming example that shows function call wiring.
sam_runtime: We can do that. Pattern: Responses streaming endpoint + function definitions + JSON schema validation. Minimal Python example to stream and handle a function call callback:
```py
# pseudo Python SSE streaming + function call handler
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
stream = client.responses.stream({
  'model': 'redwood-infer-2',
  'input': 'Score event and call create_alert with id and score when risk > 0.9',
  'functions': [{
    'name': 'create_alert',
    'parameters': { 'type': 'object', 'properties': { 'id': { 'type': 'string' }, 'score': { 'type': 'number' } }, 'required': ['id', 'score'] }
  }],
  'schema': { 'type': 'object', 'properties': { 'alert': { 'type': 'object' } }, 'required': ['alert'] }
})
for chunk in stream:
  if chunk.get('type') == 'function_call':
    # mock webhook call
    payload = chunk['arguments']
    requests.post('https://ft-internal/webhook', json=payload)
  else:
    print(chunk.get('delta'))
```
maya_se: Good. I'll package that and the curl SSE snippet. Use SDK >= 0.9.1 for schema helpers and function binding.
tess_prod: Quick notes on capacity and deployment: if they require air-gapped KMS we must move to Private on-prem which is non-trivial. For pilot runway recommend Hosted with VPC peering and BYOK (customer-managed AWS KMS) to meet most controls. That keeps timeline short.
arjun_sales: Their questionnaire explicitly says "offline KMS (FIPS HSM, no network egress)". That sounds like full air-gap.
raquel_legal: We don't support customer HSMs that are completely offline for Hosted. Private/on-prem covers that but it's an SOW + 6-10 week project typically. For pilot momentum propose: (1) provide our SOC2/pen test under NDA, (2) offer BYOK in customer VPC (customer controls keys), (3) provide architecture diagram and compensating controls. If they still insist on fully air-gapped KMS, flag as blocker.
sec-bot: SOC2 report available (redwood-soc2-2025)  access link: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025 (NDA).
raquel_legal: Also flagged: their standard contract wants product IP assignment for deliverables. We only offer standard license + work-for-hire exceptions need legal review.
maya_se: For schema enforcement, we can show two options: (A) server-side validation: responses.schema enforced by runtime so models return JSON shaped to schema, with validation errors surfaced; (B) guardrails client-side: post-validate and retry + confidence threshold. I can draft both examples.
sam_runtime: Streaming implementation notes: use prefix caching disabled for this flow if they send unrelated prompts, but recommend KV caching otherwise. Function-call flow wiring: runtime will emit a function_call event with name/arguments; client can call their webhook or mock it in the sample repo.
tess_prod: Pricing: if Hosted pilot with reserved burst capacity, estimate $X/month for the expected qps (I'll attach numbers in follow-up). If Dedicated or Private, pricing increases and requires procurement.
arjun_sales: Customer asking for 50% off for pilot. Standard play is 30% for limited trials. Can SalesOps approve 45%?
raquel_legal: Pricing approvals are not legal. :)

maya_se: Actions: 1) I'll assemble Python + Node samples, curl SSE, and a small sample repo with a mock webhook and README. 2) I'll write a short doc explaining schema enforcement behavior and function-call wiring. ETA: EOD PT.
sam_runtime: Action: I'll spin up a minimal quickstart repo (private) with a simple Dockerfile so their infra team can run locally and test SSE + function callback. ETA: tomorrow AM.
tess_prod: Action: I'll produce a pilot capacity costing + recommended deployment (Hosted+VPC BYOK) and pricing options (30% baseline, escalate to SalesOps for 40-45%).
raquel_legal: Action: I'll prepare a reply to the questionnaire items we can answer and draft SOW language to refuse IP assignment and offer standard DPA + NDA link.
arjun_sales: I'll reply to FinTrust with the sample repo link once Maya uploads it, include our SOC2 report under NDA, and propose Hosted+BYOK pilot with 30% discount pending usage cap. If they push air-gapped KMS, mark as escalation.
maya_se: Sent the bundle to FinTrust eng and ops (cc arjun). attaching repo link: https://github.com/redwood/presales/fintrust-quickstart (private).
arjun_sales: Thanks all. Please update this thread with any responses from FinTrust. :thumbsup:
